#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

helper() { :; }

# ---- Setup ----
function setup {
  cat <<EOF2
fake() {
  echo no
}
EOF2
}

function with_parens() {
  echo "multi
line() {
string"
}

### Build steps
build_all ()
{
  cat <<-'END'
	notfn() {
	END
}

# ------------------
# Deploy
# ------------------
deploy::prod() ( echo sub )
echo "foo() {"  # comment foo() {
x=$(cat <<< "here string")
after() { :; }
